source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: As the battle starts, you may place the Cadian Recon Squad’s Vox‑relay Beacon anywhere on the field outside the opponent’s deployment zone. A friendly unit with **ASTRA MILITARUM** and **REGIMENT** within 6″ of the beacon can receive [Orders](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.voice-of-command) from an **OFFICER** unit in your army as though that unit were within 6″ of the recipient. Remove the marker if an enemy unit sets up or ends a move within 1″ of it.

detail.actor: Cadian Recon Squad with Vox-relay Beacon

setup.where: on battlefield outside opponent deployment zone
